{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Check for missing values in flipper_length_mm
print('Missing values in flipper_length_mm:', penguins['flipper_length_mm'].isnull().sum())

# Compute mean flipper length by species, using default skipna=True
mean_flipper_by_species = penguins.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()

# Print the result
print('\nMean flipper length by species:\n', mean_flipper_by_species)

# Identify the species with the highest mean flipper length
highest_mean_species = mean_flipper_by_species.idxmax()
print('\nSpecies with highest mean flipper length:', highest_mean_species)"}
